verdicts.reason: Both push the logo into a tiny bottom-left corner badge jammed near the edge (it led the original from top-centre) and both pair left-aligned copy with a centred product and CTA. A sets the headline over the decorative circle and spreads headline, can and button down the canvas with big uneven gaps. B keeps headline, subcopy and CTA together as one block under the product, which reads better, though the can crowds the circle's edge and the bottom feels heavy.
